signals.text: James out for minimum of five games - Bompastor. Sonia Bompastor says Lauren James is out for at least the next few weeks, casting doubt on her availability for England's World Cup qualifying play-off matches.

'Big decisions' affected the game - Lampard. Coventry City head coach Frank Lampard is frustrated after three "big decisions" went against his side in their 3-1 defeat by Everton at the Hill Dickinson Stadium.
